label: POSITIVE V1

entryOffer.independenceScope: Each stored subset works without the listed other clues, with the same map/start/givens. Not a claim of independent human ideas.

representation.fieldMarks: Remaining cells can be marked per hour; cross-hour associations are not stored by the UI.
representation.scope: Missing cross-pairs can follow from adjacency as well as clues. Local edges need not extend to a legal route; higher-order correlations are not represented.

milestones.scope: Field milestones only; fixed edges are attached evidence, not extra milestones. Certificate ancestors are sufficient, not minimal or a human order.

possibleInterpretations: Concrete anchors and small per-hour alternatives may support practical progress; discoverability and marking effort are unmeasured.
Shared entry, witness and completion patterns may indicate repetition across a series; no similarity threshold or selection follows.
Unresolved cross-hour associations may require memory; their presence alone does not establish difficulty.
unknowns: Human solving order, thought depth, effort, difficulty and enjoyment.
All alternative human arguments and their independence.
Whether a local/exact gap is caused by a missing simple rule or a human obstacle.
